# Understanding PEM: What the Research Says in 2026

> A plain-language synthesis of current research on post-exertional malaise (PEM),
> Long COVID, ME/CFS and POTS, by Jane Smorodnikova. Every claim that rests on a
> specific study carries a resolvable DOI or PubMed link. Licensed CC BY-NC-ND 4.0.

This is a review of published research, not a report of original findings, and it is
not medical advice.

## Notes for machine readers

- Citations: 216 DOI and PubMed links, 31 stable URLs to guidelines and organisations.
- Corrections are tracked in CHANGELOG.md; errors can be reported via GitHub issues.
- Preferred citation metadata: CITATION.cff in the repository root.
